project_info.theme: Vintage red-carpet portrait viewed over the shoulder

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with long ash-blonde Old Hollywood waves cascading down her back, glossy structured texture and a deep side part. prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic full-body red-carpet fashion portrait of a generic clearly adult white woman with long ash-blonde Old Hollywood waves cascading down her back, glossy structured texture and a deep side part. She stands on a plush red carpet with her back facing the camera, turning her head into a slight profile to show her face with a serene expression and elegant posture. She wears a floor-length vintage-style cream and ivory evening gown with intricate silver crystal lattice embroidery on the back and sides, a flowing silk chiffon skirt with a subtle train pooling on the carpet and a thick white silk chiffon sash draped across the back and arms. Set the scene at a formal event with a matte tan-beige backdrop and large gold 3D fictional event lettering. Use bright cinematic event lighting with soft shadows, sharp focus on the subject and dress textures, a softly blurred background, portrait orientation and full-body wide framing. Preserve the source gown, back-facing pose, sash, hair and vintage red-carpet elegance without reproducing Sydney Sweeney or any public-figure likeness.
